company.shortDescription: UserTesting is an on-demand human insight platform designed to improve customer insights.
company.description:
UserTesting is an on-demand human insights platform that empowers organizations to make timely, customer-centric business decisions with confidence. With UserTesting, brands can target their exact customer audience, readily create and execute studies, and engage in live conversations to better understand, capture, and spotlight meaningful reactions and responses.

Easily package these human insights into a video reel and share them across the organization to make more informed decisions that influence the customer experience and increase brand loyalty and revenue.

aiResearchSummary.text: UserTesting is researching a system and method for custom label embedding that uses a computer-based method to identify test user intent during evaluation of user interaction with a digital asset. The abstract describes receiving test user interaction data, transforming it into a vector, and using a machine learning model to project this vector into a non‑custom embedding space to infer intent. This work focuses on intent detection and interaction analysis for customer insight generation.
